method: Re-solved each displayed sentence against all four choices and then checked stored proposed answer/explanation; uniqueness, naturalness, target-skill fit, distractor validity, and explanation consistency reviewed item by item. Note: source format co-locates proposed answers with stems, so strict answer-blinding was not technically enforceable in this connector-only run; no item was promoted without individual review.
notes: All 25 items uniquely require a gerund complement among the displayed choices. The suggest, keep, practice, mind, and admit patterns are grammatically valid in the displayed contexts, and the stored explanations are consistent with the keyed gerund forms. Some subject-role contexts are template-like, but none creates an alternate correct choice in this checkpoint. Full cross-bank semantic near-duplicate clearance remains outstanding.
